rules.name: encoding-01-client-dripping-structure-name
rules.sql: SELECT business_unit, count(*) AS row_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE structure_name LIKE '%' || chr(63) || '%') AS with_question_mark, count(*) FILTER (WHERE structure_name ~ ('[' || chr(194) || chr(195) || chr(226) || ']')) AS with_win1252_signs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE position(chr(8482) in structure_name) > 0) AS with_trade_mark_sign, count(*) FILTER (WHERE structure_name !~ '^[ -~]*$') AS with_non_ascii FROM opera.client_dripping_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY business_unit ORDER BY business_unit

SELECT 'CFS' AS business_unit, CAST(count(*) AS SIGNED) AS row_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(structure_name LIKE CONCAT('%', CHAR(63), '%')), 0) AS SIGNED) AS with_question_mark, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(INSTR(structure_name, CONVERT(UNHEX('E284A2') USING utf8mb4)) > 0), 0) AS SIGNED) AS with_trade_mark_sign, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(structure_name NOT REGEXP '^[ -~]*$'), 0) AS SIGNED) AS with_non_ascii FROM dbsystemuat.client_dripping_table_cfs UNION ALL SELECT 'RMC', CAST(count(*) AS SIGNED), CAST(COALESCE(SUM(structure_name LIKE CONCAT('%', CHAR(63), '%')), 0) AS SIGNED), CAST(COALESCE(SUM(INSTR(structure_name, CONVERT(UNHEX('E284A2') USING utf8mb4)) > 0), 0) AS SIGNED), CAST(COALESCE(SUM(structure_name NOT REGEXP '^[ -~]*$'), 0) AS SIGNED) FROM dbsystemuat.client_dripping_table_rmc

SELECT business_unit, structure_name, count(*) AS row_count, min(created_by) AS created_by_min, max(created_by) AS created_by_max, min(created_timestamp) AS first_created, max(created_timestamp) AS last_created FROM opera.client_dripping_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND (structure_name LIKE '%' || chr(63) || '%' OR structure_name ~ ('[' || chr(194) || chr(195) || chr(226) || ']')) GROUP BY business_unit, structure_name ORDER BY business_unit, structure_name

SELECT 'CFS' AS business_unit, t.v AS structure_name, count(*) AS row_count FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(SUBSTRING(REPLACE(REPLACE(CONVERT(structure_name USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin, CHAR(0), ''), CHAR(13), ''), 1, 100), '(null)') AS v FROM dbsystemuat.client_dripping_table_cfs ) t GROUP BY t.v UNION ALL SELECT 'RMC' AS business_unit, t.v AS structure_name, count(*) AS row_count FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(SUBSTRING(REPLACE(REPLACE(CONVERT(structure_name USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin, CHAR(0), ''), CHAR(13), ''), 1, 100), '(null)') AS v FROM dbsystemuat.client_dripping_table_rmc ) t GROUP BY t.v

SELECT business_unit, COALESCE(substr(structure_name, 1, 100), '(null)') AS structure_name, count(*) AS row_count FROM opera.client_dripping_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit IN ('CFS', 'RMC') GROUP BY business_unit, COALESCE(substr(structure_name, 1, 100), '(null)')

expect.reason: the new table must hold dripping rows for this tenant (a wrong tenant parameter gives 0)
no structure name may contain a question mark (the loader did not read UTF-8)
no structure name may hold UTF-8 read as WIN1252
if legacy already has a question mark the source is damaged and a reload cannot repair it

a structure name present on both sides is identical. Names on one side only are listed for reading, not judged: legacy gets new structures and drops old ones after the load, so only the question mark checks above decide the verdict
